name: finsight-backend
description: FinSight Backend — Next.js Route Handlers + TypeScript + Supabase

scripts.clean:deep: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item .next -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path .turbo) { Remove-Item .turbo -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path node_modules/.cache) { Remove-Item node_modules/.cache -Recurse -Force }"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.dev:reset: npm run clean:deep && npm run dev
scripts.lint: eslint app config middleware modules rbac types utils --ext .ts
